entities.name: Łukasz Kaczmarek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Łukasz Kaczmarek is a Polish professional volleyball player who plays as an opposite spiker for Jastrzębski Węgiel and the Poland national team. Kaczmarek took part in the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo and won silver at the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris. He was a silver medallist with Poland at the 2022 World Championship. He is a three–time Champions League winner with ZAKSA.
